summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: @servicetitan/temporal-lite 3.4.7 declares itself as a small Temporal date/time polyfill, but ships a preinstall lifecycle (`scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`) that at `npm install` time downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to `execFileSync` a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with hex-named identifiers and a string-array rotation routine (`WV8StW`); no source is shipped and its contents are not human-readable. The package's `dist/` tree contains only ordinary Temporal polyfill code with no reference to Bun or `math_init.js`, there is no native source or `binding.gyp` that would justify a second runtime, and the repository URL points at an unrelated UI monorepo. The alternate-runtime execution path exists solely to run opaque code on the installer's machine at install time and to evade Node-based static analysis, which the Node interpreter never touches.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
